observation: A readiness review found occurrence explanations cover only 125 of 37,697 edges, the link-prediction suite is not the competition protocol (five negatives per positive, no GNN, no Pharos baseline comparison), and there is no keep/prune verdict file, no KGX/BioLink export and no public demo. The review measured micro AUPRC 0.9404 static, 0.8688 enriched and 0.7829 pruned, and recommended prioritising a public demo and a real comparison against Pharos.
